title: The Ephemeral Cost of Switching Optimizers Across LLM Training Stages
abstract: arXiv:2610.22650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work suggests that switching optimizers between pretraining and subsequent training stages incurs a performance cost, but systematic investigation of this phenomenon is lacking. We study the mismatch between AdamW and Muon optimizers by pretraining 1.2B Llama-3 models from scratch while varying the proportion of updates taken with each optimizer, and similarly interpolating between the two optimizers during continued pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Surprisingly, we find little evidence of a meaningful optimizer mismatch penalty: final performance is largely explained by the independent effects of the pretraining and post-training optimizers, with downstream performance generally improving as the proportion of Muon updates during SFT increases. Although matching the pretraining optimizer can reduce forgetting during SFT, this does not translate into improved final benchmark performance. We further evaluate AdamW and M

translated_title: 跨LLM训练阶段切换优化器的短暂代价
translated_abstract: 最近的研究表明，在预训练和后续训练阶段之间切换优化器会带来性能损失，但缺乏对这一现象的系统性研究。我们通过从头预训练1.2B参数的Llama-3模型，并改变使用每种优化器进行更新的比例，来研究AdamW与Muon优化器之间的不匹配问题，同时在继续预训练和监督微调（SFT）期间对两种优化器进行类似的插值实验。令人惊讶的是，我们发现几乎没有证据表明存在有意义的优化器不匹配惩罚：最终性能在很大程度上可以由预训练和后训练优化器的独立效应来解释，且随着SFT期间Muon更新比例的增加，下游性能总体上有所提升。尽管匹配预训练优化器可以减少SFT期间的遗忘，但这并不能转化为最终基准测试性能的提升。我们进一步评估了AdamW和M……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过系统性实验首次发现，在LLM预训练与后训练阶段之间切换优化器（如AdamW与Muon之间）并不会造成实质性的性能损失，最终性能主要由各阶段所用优化器的独立效应决定，且在SFT中增加Muon更新比例反而能提升下游性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through systematic experiments that switching optimizers (e.g., between AdamW and Muon) across LLM pretraining and post-training stages incurs no meaningful performance penalty, as final performance is largely determined by the independent effects of each stage's optimizer, with more Muon updates during SFT even improving downstream performance.
